declared_before_viewing: any between-profile difference of scores; only coverage, timing and ledger summaries of the audit outcome had been viewed
applies_rule: admission_rules_v2.json (ratified 2026-10-23); this file only fixes interpretation, it changes no threshold

1_margin_comparison.metric: ROUGE-L F1, per-ID paired difference, mean over C_between
1_margin_comparison.comparison: difference >= 0.01 - 1e-12 passes (a value exactly on the threshold passes; the epsilon only absorbs float artefacts)
1_margin_comparison.leader_must_beat: every other admitted representative, each by the margin

2_partial_coverage.rule: if any admitted profile or C_between misses a coverage/common floor of admission_rules_v2, or the scoring run was partial, the result is no_selection; never evaluated on a completed prefix

3_stratum_direction.reversal: the leader-minus-rival mean ROUGE-L difference in a considered stratum has the strictly opposite sign to the overall difference

4_lead3_guard.definition: leader minus Lead-3 mean ROUGE-L >= 0.0 on C_between and in every considered stratum (same epsilon)
4_lead3_guard.valid_139: Lead-3 valid:139 is cut mid-sentence at 350 words per the declared baseline; scores kept unchanged; reported as a descriptive note only

5_exact_ties.rule: exact tie (difference == 0.0) resolved by config_priority_for_exact_ties in selection300_profiles_v2.json, then stable profile ID; a difference below the margin is no_selection, not a tie-break
